kit_properties: Every number in every draft matches the Fact Sheet or a story's own numbers.
No draft names a person whose story marks them as not to be named.
No sentence uses any of these words: passionate, journey, impactful, rockstar, crushed it, my why, I went with my gut, I am proud of, I winged it, amazing.

The goals essay names the short-term goal specifically: An investment or value-creation role at a mid-market private-equity fund in Frankfurt, Munich or London, on German-speaking industrials: the businesses too small for the large funds and too operational for the banks.
The leadership essay leads with "The programme the owner signed", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
The setback essay leads with "The section I rewrote without asking", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
